name: MedicalRecord
description: Stores a patient's electronic health record entries, including visit details, diagnoses, treatments, and prescriptions.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: Owning patient's User ID. Set automatically on create from the authenticated user (if patient creates) or derived from the patient linked to the doctor's action; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may update/delete.

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: ID of the doctor who authored this medical record entry (references Doctor.idOfUser).

attributes.name: visitDate
attributes.description: The date of the patient's visit or when the record entry was made.

attributes.name: diagnosis
attributes.description: The diagnosis recorded for the patient.

attributes.name: treatment
attributes.description: The treatment plan prescribed or administered.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Clinical notes related to the patient's visit or condition.

attributes.name: recordType
attributes.description: The type of medical record entry.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the medical record entry.
